text:
Predicates:
JapaneseCompany(x) ::: x is a Japanese game company.
Created(x, y) ::: x created y.
Top10(y) ::: y is on the Top 10 list.
SellsMoreThanOneMillionCopies(y) ::: y sells more than one million copies.
Premises:
JapaneseCompany(japaneseGameCompany) ∧ Created(japaneseGameCompany, legendOfZelda) ::: A Japanese game company created the game the Legend of Zelda.
∀x (Top10(x) → JapaneseCompany(x)) ::: All games on the Top 10 list are made by Japanese game companies.
∀x (SellsMoreThanOneMillionCopies(x) → Top10(x)) ::: If a game sells more than one million copies, then it will be included in the Top 10 list.
SellsMoreThanOneMillionCopies(legendOfZelda) ::: The Legend of Zelda sold more than one million copies.
Conclusion:
Top10(legendOfZelda) ::: The Legend of Zelda is on the Top 10 list.
